title: Adversary Brains: Hypothesis-Based Logical Signatures for Threat Actor Detection with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.35624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An adversary brain is an LLM-based model of a threat actor's behavior, held as an evolving logical signature: a hypothesis with enough structure that data can test it continuously, without a person re-interpreting it each time. Rather than any single observation, such as an IoC (Indicator of Compromise), it is the arrangement that becomes a detection, or intelligence, mechanism. Where YARA matches a file and Sigma matches a log line, an adversary brain matches the activity pattern of a campaign or threat actor. This is based on an intelligence analysis technique called Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH), which the design lifts from the limitation of a few hypotheses at a time, to thousands, and then also operationalizes it for continuous detection purposes. translated_title: 对手大脑：利用大语言模型进行威胁行为者检测的基于假设的逻辑签名
translated_abstract: 对手大脑（Adversary Brain）是一种基于大语言模型的威胁行为者行为模型，以不断演化的逻辑签名形式存在：它是一个具有足够结构化程度的假设，使数据能够持续对其进行检验，而无需人工每次重新解读。不同于任何单一观测（如失陷指标IoC），正是这种整体组织结构本身构成了检测或情报机制。YARA匹配的是文件，Sigma匹配的是日志行，而对手大脑匹配的是攻击活动或威胁行为者的活动模式。该方法基于一种名为竞争假设分析（ACH）的情报分析技术，本设计突破了其一次仅能处理少量假设的限制，将其扩展至数千个假设的规模，并将其运用于持续检测。语言模型使这一概念及其规模化变得切实可行：它们将文本报告转化为大脑、判断匹配情况，并驱动保持大脑时效性的循环。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“对手大脑”概念——利用大语言模型将威胁情报报告转化为可演化的基于假设的逻辑签名，借鉴竞争假设分析法（ACH）并将其从少量假设扩展至数千个规模，从而实现对威胁行为者活动模式的持续自动化检测，弥补了YARA、Sigma等单一指标匹配的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Adversary Brains" — LLM-based, evolving logical signatures that model threat actor behavior as structured hypotheses, scaling the Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH) from a few hypotheses to thousands for continuous, automated detection of threat actor activity patterns beyond single-indicator matching like YARA and Sigma.
